selection_authority: Existing exact current grant payload, exact Root inspection receipt, and reviewed Source type definitions only

source_fields.Source: payload.binding.backup; must equal payload.pins entry role encrypted-backup-manifest
source_fields.name: backup-manifest.json
source_fields.validation: Byte-exact pinned BackupManifest JSON with format,id,started_at,snapshot_completed_at,migrations,schema_hash,runtime_versions,files,inventory,key_policy,cache_policy,mac and optional purpose; verify synthetic prepared-abandonment purpose, source23 and matching rehearsal backup_manifest hash/bytes. Never follow files/inventory/purpose refs.

source_fields.Source: payload.binding.rehearsal; must equal payload.pins entry role isolated-restore-rehearsal
source_fields.name: prepared-abandonment-rehearsal.json
source_fields.validation: Byte-exact pinned researchos.prepared-abandonment-schema-rehearsal.v1 receipt; require exact reviewed struct fields, plan/status and binding digests. options.KeyFile is a path string, never read; no options path is traversed. Existing harness-facts/rehearsal.public.json is reserialized and is not assumed byte-identical.

source_fields.Source: each payload.pins entry whose role is source-inventory:<relative-path> or target-inventory:<relative-path>
source_fields.name: explicit unique flat name for each side and relative path
source_fields.validation: Use only exact enumerated current grant entries: source23=27 members and target24=28 members, including all numbered SQL and four known contract JSON files; match role suffix, corresponding options.SourceRoot/TargetRoot path, expected Source hard-coded digest and actual pin. No recursive walk/glob for archive selection. Byte-exact data copy; SHA/path/bytes indexed by role in archive manifest.

source_fields.name: explicit unique basename per current payload pin
source_fields.validation: Required only to retain complete dynamic grant raw-pin closure. Copy explicit pinned .enc bytes as opaque data; do not decrypt, decompress, parse embedded refs, read DB or read backup key. If this kind is excluded or not authorized, state partial-public-evidence closure and no retained decryptability/restore claim.

inventory_semantics: SourceInventory and TargetInventory are in-memory relative-path -> SHA maps, not original standalone inventory JSON files. Preserve their exact member bytes and original grant refs, then reconstruct maps and check binding.source_inventory_sha256 / target_inventory_sha256 with the reviewed canonical hash. Any newly written map is derived evidence, not byte-exact original inventory JSON.
archive_requirements: Create fresh output under persistent receipts before fixture release/cleanup.
Record original source pin and archive pin for each exact member; require SHA and bytes equal and read back copied bytes.
Reverify explicit source pins after copying and guard public Source/receipt inputs as appropriate.
Do not rewrite grant, snapshot, source path or original evidence to point at archive; publish explicit source-to-archive mapping.
Root independently reviews copy closure before permitting fixture release. No TTL extension.
forbidden: backup key or private issuer/root key resource
recursive following of nested public JSON paths
arbitrary JSON/SQL not enumerated by exact current grant inventory
decryption or any extra model/trial operation
